cohort: The study included 510 preterm neonates admitted to Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICU) at public hospitals in west Guji and Borena zones, Oromia National Regional State, southern Ethiopia.
finding: Lack of antenatal care, primiparity, pregnancy complications, resuscitation at birth, and not receiving Kangaroo mother care were significant predictors of preterm neonatal death.
followup_time: Up to 28 days post-birth or until discharge
